verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is a pricing-page bullet listing "Call Intelligence & sequences" as a plan feature, which suggests a native sequences capability but gives no detail on how it works. "Draft follow-ups" is AI drafting, and the Workflows "sequences of automated actions" are automation blocks, so neither shows email sending; the SDK items are developer building blocks and earn no credit. Missing for 10: any documentation of email templates, of sending email from inside the CRM, of multi-step sequence configuration (steps, delays, enrollment), and any hands-on or independent corroboration.
